description: Parameters defining document quality variations for OCR testing
purpose: Standardize quality definitions across tests to ensure consistent evaluation of OCR accuracy under different quality conditions

high.description: High quality documents with optimal characteristics for OCR processing

resolution.description: Document resolution in dots per inch
resolution.impact: Higher resolution provides more detail for character recognition

contrast.description: Normalized contrast ratio between text and background
contrast.impact: Higher contrast improves character boundary detection

noise_level.description: Normalized noise ratio (0.0 = no noise, 1.0 = maximum noise)
noise_level.impact: Lower noise reduces false character detection

blur.impact: Lower blur preserves character edge definition

skew_angle.impact: Minimal skew improves line and paragraph detection

compression_artifacts.description: JPEG compression quality loss (0.0 = lossless, 1.0 = maximum loss)
compression_artifacts.impact: Lower compression artifacts preserve character details

lighting_uniformity.description: Uniformity of lighting across document (1.0 = perfectly uniform)
lighting_uniformity.impact: Uniform lighting ensures consistent character detection

field_extraction_accuracy.description: Expected accuracy for structured field extraction

confidence_score.description: Expected confidence score range for extracted data

processing_time_factor.description: Baseline processing time multiplier (1.0 = standard processing time)

medium.description: Medium quality documents with moderate imperfections that may affect OCR accuracy

resolution.description: Document resolution in dots per inch
resolution.impact: Medium resolution may lose some character details

contrast.description: Normalized contrast ratio between text and background
contrast.impact: Moderate contrast may affect character boundary detection

noise_level.description: Normalized noise ratio (0.0 = no noise, 1.0 = maximum noise)
noise_level.impact: Moderate noise may cause occasional character misidentification

blur.impact: Moderate blur affects character edge definition

compression_artifacts.description: JPEG compression quality loss (0.0 = lossless, 1.0 = maximum loss)
compression_artifacts.impact: Moderate compression artifacts affect character details

lighting_uniformity.description: Uniformity of lighting across document (1.0 = perfectly uniform)
lighting_uniformity.impact: Moderately non-uniform lighting may affect character detection in some areas

field_extraction_accuracy.description: Expected accuracy for structured field extraction

confidence_score.description: Expected confidence score range for extracted data

processing_time_factor.description: Processing time multiplier compared to high quality (1.5x longer)

low.description: Low quality documents with significant imperfections that challenge OCR accuracy

resolution.description: Document resolution in dots per inch
resolution.impact: Low resolution significantly impacts character recognition

contrast.description: Normalized contrast ratio between text and background
contrast.impact: Low contrast makes character boundary detection difficult

noise_level.description: Normalized noise ratio (0.0 = no noise, 1.0 = maximum noise)
noise_level.impact: High noise levels frequently cause character misidentification

blur.impact: Significant blur severely affects character edge definition

compression_artifacts.description: JPEG compression quality loss (0.0 = lossless, 1.0 = maximum loss)
compression_artifacts.impact: Significant compression artifacts degrade character details

lighting_uniformity.description: Uniformity of lighting across document (1.0 = perfectly uniform)
lighting_uniformity.impact: Non-uniform lighting significantly affects character detection

field_extraction_accuracy.description: Expected accuracy for structured field extraction

confidence_score.description: Expected confidence score range for extracted data

processing_time_factor.description: Processing time multiplier compared to high quality (2.5x longer)

accuracy.description: Percentage of correctly extracted characters or fields

precision.description: Percentage of extracted data that is correct

recall.description: Percentage of actual data that was correctly extracted

f1_score.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall

processing_time.description: Time taken to process a document in seconds
